rules.conditions:
WHEN any of the following occur
A new issue is created
An issue escalates
A resolved issue regresses
IF all of these filters match
The event's operational.area tag equals payment
The event's level greater than or equal error
THEN perform these actions
Notify James Lawrence
rules.connectedProjects:
All issues belonging to a connected project will trigger this alert when conditions are met.
